indicationQuote: EPIDIOLEX is indicated for the treatment of seizures associated with Lennox-Gastaut syndrome (LGS), Dravet syndrome (DS), or tuberous sclerosis complex (TSC) in patients 1 year of age and older.
targetsNote: Anti-seizure medicine; the label states the anticonvulsant mechanism is unknown and it does not act on the SCN1A/Nav1.1 defect.

indicationQuote: FINTEPLA is indicated for the treatment of seizures associated with Dravet syndrome (DS) and Lennox-Gastaut syndrome (LGS) in patients 2 years of age and older.
targetsNote: Anti-seizure medicine (serotonergic/sigma-1 activity per label pharmacodynamics); the label states the precise mechanism is unknown and it does not act on the SCN1A defect.

indicationQuote: DIACOMIT is indicated for the treatment of seizures associated with Dravet syndrome (DS) in patients taking clobazam who are 6 months of age and older and weighing 7 kg or more.
targetsNote: Anti-seizure medicine used with clobazam; the label states the anticonvulsant mechanism is unknown and it does not act on the SCN1A defect.

indicationQuote: DAYBUE and DAYBUE STIX are indicated for the treatment of Rett syndrome in adults and pediatric patients 2 years of age and older.
targetsNote: Synthetic IGF-1-derived tripeptide analog; the label states the mechanism in Rett syndrome is unknown and it does not act on MECP2 or its protein, so classified as symptoms (uncertain; arguably downstream-pathway).

indicationQuote: ZTALMY is indicated for the treatment of seizures associated with cyclin-dependent kinase-like 5 (CDKL5) deficiency disorder (CDD) in patients 2 years of age and older.
targetsNote: Neuroactive steroid GABA-A receptor positive allosteric modulator (anti-seizure); does not act on the CDKL5 kinase defect.

indicationQuote: AFINITOR and AFINITOR DISPERZ® are indicated in adult and pediatric patients aged 1 year and older with TSC for the treatment of SEGA that requires therapeutic intervention but cannot be curatively resected. AFINITOR DISPERZ is indicated for the adjunctive treatment of adult and pediatric patients aged 2 years and older with TSC-associated partial-onset seizures.
targetsNote: mTOR inhibitor acting on the pathway that TSC1/TSC2 loss over-activates; the label notes the mTOR pathway is dysregulated in tuberous sclerosis complex.
